## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not duplicate or conflict with another open PR.
- [ ] Security assumptions, failure modes, and rollback/compatibility implications are explained.
- [ ] Review comments have been addressed and all conversations are resolved before merge.
- [ ] Required independent approvals and repository ruleset checks are satisfied before merge.

## Release status

- [ ] No production rollout is implied by passing CI alone.
- [ ] Any required staging, provider-specific, or release-gate evidence is attached or linked.
